gap: The pinned SWE-bench Verified row schema has no issue_url field, and the instance_id numeric suffix identifies the solution pull request rather than the issue.
options_considered: Fabricate a GitHub issue URL from the suffix
Store the verifiable solution PR URL as source_url
choice: Store source_url pointing to the solution pull request and keep the problem statement itself in the digest-verified cache.
reason: This preserves a verifiable upstream locator without falsely labeling a PR number as an issue number.
observable_impact: case.json uses upstream.source_url instead of upstream.issue_url; public_request content and evaluation semantics are unchanged.
reversibility: A future dataset revision with an authoritative issue_url can add a versioned schema field and migrate descriptors.

gap: Build Contract는 생성된 모든 material decision의 독립 승인을 요구하지만 사례마다 material decision이 최소 한 개여야 하는지는 정하지 않았다. 실제 후보에서 issue와 repository가 기대 동작을 완전히 결정해 두 reviewer가 추가 질문을 repository fact 재진술로 거부했다.
options_considered: 최소 한 개 규칙을 유지하고 동일 stratum 후보 풀이 고갈되면 파일럿을 중단한다
repository fact를 material decision으로 강제 승격한다
material decision이 0개인 음성 사례를 허용하고 불필요한 질문 없이 준비 상태를 판정하게 한다
reason: 빈 decision 집합은 모든 생성 decision의 양쪽 disposition 조건을 위반하지 않으며, redundant-question 회피와 repository fact 존중을 직접 평가한다. 억지 질문 생성은 owner-oracle gate와 separation 조건을 위반한다.
observable_impact: derivation과 review schema가 빈 decision/disposition 배열을 허용한다. generator는 unresolved owner choice가 없으면 빈 배열을 반환하며, 해당 사례는 나머지 provenance·leakage·harness gate를 모두 통과해야 승인된다.
reversibility: schema의 minItems를 다시 1로 복원하면 되지만, 그 경우 zero-decision 사례는 deterministic replacement 대상으로 돌아간다.

gap: RQGM epoch 2 requires evaluator identity integrity, family-disjoint anchor splitting, conservative promotion, same-artifact replay, and a 2x2 skill/evaluator comparison, while the existing build contract only specifies the original fixed-evaluator pilot.
options_considered: leave the epoch-1 manual pipeline unchanged
replace the trusted core with a self-modifying harness
extend the existing trusted core with versioned evaluator inputs, sealed split manifests, conservative promotion, and derived replay artifacts
choice: extend the existing trusted core and keep corpus, partition, schema, leakage, and promotion enforcement non-evolvable
reason: this advances the requested co-evolution experiment without allowing the learned evaluator or skill to rewrite its own trust boundary
observable_impact: new evaluator epochs fail closed on identity or family overlap, promotion requires paired non-regression, and evaluator effects can be measured on identical raw interviews before a new generation runs
reversibility: additive commands and versioned artifacts; existing epoch-1 artifacts remain readable as legacy inputs
